How Much Does Lawn Mowing Cost in Ipswich? A Straight Answer

Most people want a number before they ask for a quote. Here is the honest range for Ipswich, what moves it up or down, and how to pay less per visit.

22 September 2026 5 min read Ipswich & Springfield, QLD

Nobody likes asking for a quote without some idea of the answer, so here it is. Prices below are a guide to what Ipswich and Springfield homeowners typically pay a professional, insured lawn service in 2026. Your exact price depends on the block, which is why we quote from your address and a photo rather than a one-size-fits-all rate.

Typical lawn mowing prices in Ipswich

LawnTypical blockGuide price per visit
SmallTownhouse, courtyard or new-estate front and back under ~300 m² of grass$55–$75
StandardMost Ipswich suburban blocks, 300–600 m² of grass, verge included$70–$100
LargeBig back yards, corner blocks, 600–1,000 m² of grass$95–$150
AcreageRural fringe and small acreage, quoted on siteFrom $150, often hourly

Those figures cover a proper visit: mow, edges along paths and driveways, whipper-snipping, the nature strip, a blow-down and the clippings taken away. A "mow only" price with no edges is cheaper but the yard never looks finished.

What moves the price up or down

  • How long the grass is. A fortnightly cut is quick. A lawn that has not been mowed for two months is a clean-up job: double handling, more clippings, often a brushcutter first. Expect a one-off clean-up to cost two to three times a scheduled visit.
  • Access. Side gates narrower than a mower, steep slopes, steps and lots of obstacles (trampolines, clotheslines, garden ornaments) all add time.
  • Edges and verges. Corner blocks have twice the kerb and footpath to edge. Long driveways and lots of garden beds add up too.
  • Clippings. Removing clippings from site costs more than mulching them back in. Most clients want them gone.
  • Frequency. This is the big one. A scheduled fortnightly client pays less per visit than a one-off, because the lawn is always in good condition and the visit is predictable.

Hourly rates vs a fixed price

Searches for "lawn mowing cost per hour" are common, but an hourly rate is hard to compare because a slow operator with a small domestic mower takes twice as long as a professional with commercial gear. A fixed price per visit for your property is simpler, and it is what most Ipswich lawn services (including us) offer for regular work. Hourly makes sense for acreage, clean-ups and garden work where the scope is open-ended.

Why cheap quotes often cost more

Very low prices usually mean no insurance, no edges, no clippings removed, or a mower that scalps the lawn. Scalping buffalo in summer, or mowing wet couch with a blunt blade, can cost you a lawn repair that is worth months of mowing. Ask any quote what is included, whether they are insured, and what equipment they use.

What Beg Your Garden charges

We quote each property individually, from your address and a photo, usually the same day. Scheduled clients get a fixed price per visit, a set route day, a reminder before each visit and a photo after. There is no contract. Edges, verge, blow-down and clippings removal are always included.

Frequently asked questions

What is the average cost of lawn mowing in Ipswich?

Most standard Ipswich blocks fall between about $70 and $100 per visit for a full service with edges, verge and clippings removed. Small courtyards are less, large and corner blocks more.

Is it cheaper to have lawn mowing done regularly?

Yes. Scheduled fortnightly or monthly mowing is priced lower per visit than one-off jobs because the lawn is always manageable and the visit is predictable.

Do lawn mowing prices include edges and the verge?

With Beg Your Garden, yes. Some operators quote mow-only and add edges, verge and clippings removal on top, so always ask what is included.

How much does an overgrown lawn clean-up cost?

Usually two to three times a scheduled visit, depending on how long the grass is and how much green waste needs removing. We quote it from a photo.
